title: Apply lazy loading to photo column in admin directory

requirements.text: In the AdminDirectory component's photo column (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/div[4]/div[1]/div[3]/div[2]/div[1]/div[1]/table[1]/thead[1]/tr[1]/th[4]), apply lazy loading to all leader images (PM, state leaders, and constituency leaders) that are currently displayed as circular masked previews. Use the existing LazyImage component from frontend/src/components/LazyImage.tsx to implement this functionality.

quotes: In this photo column in the admin directory oage, we're currently show the leader's images (PM, state, and constituency leaders) as a circular masked preview, please apply lazy loading for all the images

acceptanceCriteria: All leader images in the photo column use the LazyImage component for lazy loading
Images maintain their existing circular masked preview appearance
Images load only when they enter the viewport
Placeholder or loading state is shown before images are loaded

constraints: Only modify the photo column rendering logic in AdminDirectory.tsx
Do not modify any UI layout, table structure, or other columns
Do not modify any other files besides AdminDirectory.tsx
Preserve all existing visual styling including circular masking
Do not change the data structure or table architecture
nonGoals: Changing other columns in the admin directory
Modifying any components other than AdminDirectory
Adding new features beyond lazy loading
